CREATE TABLE "public"."Scalars" (
  "string" text NOT NULL,
  "stringOpt" text,
  "stringList" text[],
  "boolean" bool NOT NULL,
  "booleanOpt" bool,
  "booleanList" bool[],
  "int" int4 NOT NULL,
  "intOpt" int4,
  "intList" int4[],
  "bigInt" int8 NOT NULL,
  "bigIntOpt" int8,
  "bigIntList" int8[],
  "float" float8 NOT NULL,
  "floatOpt" float8,
  "floatList" float8[],
  "decimal" numeric(65,30) NOT NULL,
  "decimalOpt" numeric(65,30),
  "decimalList" numeric(65,30)[],
  "dateTime" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "dateTimeOpt" timestamp(3),
  "dateTimeList" timestamp(3)[],
  "json" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "jsonOpt" jsonb,
  "jsonList" jsonb[],
  "bytes" bytea NOT NULL,
  "bytesOpt" bytea,
  "bytesList" bytea[],
  PRIMARY KEY ("int")
)
